notes.title: Gameplay update
notes.content:
[H2] new: [/ H2]
[list]
[*] circuit system enables players to create the second time in the game
[*] dig the ground. Click the pick in the item bar and then click the open space to dig
[*] mow. Click sickle in the item bar and then click grass to mow
[*] furnace, used to refine ore and get metal. Right click to start
[*] well, get water, right-click to start
[*] extractor, to convert some materials into another substance, right-click the mouse to start the operation
[*] add German, Russian, Korean, English, Spanish, Italian, French and other localized languages
[*]
[/list]
ːsteamthumbsupː
[H2] update: [/ H2]
[list]
[*] equipment system, enchant entry instead of strengthen + 15
[*] the monster appearance mechanism is temporarily unified to appear when digging
[*] temporarily removed the ground brush mechanism
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Re generated the map, adjusted the ore, vegetation distribution
[*] Increased camp, stay in camp can slow blood return
[*] Added wild wolf
[*] Added field boss, long Aotian
[*] Recreated the monster drop mechanism
[*] Recreated the performance of dropped items
[*] The equipment synthesis formula was made again, and the equipment value and equipment growth were adjusted
[*] The synthetic formula of common articles was made again
[*] Remake the main character combat value
[*] The buff system is remade, and the relevant functions and interfaces of buff system are adjusted
[*] A hammer tool has been added, which can be used to remove unwanted decorative objects
[*] Temporarily removed access to secondary maps
[/list]
